_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score is in a documented coil (only 6% of 12h windows moved ±2); no breaker (flat funding, dead ETF flows, VIX 16.46) so HOLD inside Hope is the graded base-rate call.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicit HOLD/CAUTION in Hope; narrative is flow-positive color only and silent on forward phase/direction
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed holds 55-70, funding near flat, BTC chops with no momentum or ETF-flow impulse
next_move.invalidated_if: Momentum + funding + ETF flows lift together through score 71, or crowded longs unwind with Fear & Greed under 55 and VIX rising
